relationships.evidence_quote: we revealed that the TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway induced upregulation of voltage-gated sodium channel 1.7 (Nav1.7) in DRGs, triggering peripheral hyperalgesia in SMIR-induced CPSP

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: In the central nervous system, the TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway participated in SMIR-induced CPSP by activating microglia in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of the peripheral and central TLR4/NF-κB signaling pathway involved in the development of SMIR-induced CPSP

key_findings: TLR4 expression rose in spinal dorsal horn and DRG of SMIR rats, expressed in neurons and microglia (cord) but neurons not satellite glia (DRG)
